text:
The change specification for `20261104-120000-bugfix-useroutref-startup` has been submitted and validated across `header.json` and `units-001.json`:

- **Reproducing tests (`U01`–`U03`)**:
  - [`RouteResolver.test.ts`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/routing/RouteResolver.test.ts): Verifies [`RouteResolver.resolve`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/routing/RouteResolver.ts#L193-L248) returns `undefined` instead of throwing `No path for ...` when an ancestor `RouteRef` has no path in `routePaths`.
  - [`useRouteRef.test.tsx`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.test.tsx): Verifies [`useRouteRef`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.tsx#L36-L51) subscribes to `routeResolutionApi.subscribe`, re-resolves when notified, and cleans up on unmount.
  - [`createSpecializedApp.test.tsx`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/createSpecializedApp.test.tsx): Reproduces the `app/root.elements` banner startup crash under `prepareSpecializedApp` and verifies that the banner renders `undefined` during bootstrap, updates to the resolved route after `finalize()`, and keeps a bounded render count.
- **Codegen, documentation, and changesets (`U04`–`U11`)**:
  - [`RouteResolutionApi.ts`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/apis/definitions/RouteResolutionApi.ts#L47-L61): Adds optional `subscribe?(listener: () => void): () => void` to [`RouteResolutionApi`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/apis/definitions/RouteResolutionApi.ts#L47-L61).
  - [`RouteResolver.ts`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/routing/RouteResolver.ts#L92-L248): Returns `undefined` in [`resolveBasePath`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/routing/RouteResolver.ts#L92-L164) and [`RouteResolver.resolve`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/routing/RouteResolver.ts#L193-L248) when an ancestor route ref has no registered path.
  - [`phaseApis.tsx`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/phaseApis.tsx#L113-L165): Implements `subscribe` on [`RouteResolutionApiProxy`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/phaseApis.tsx#L113-L165) and notifies listeners on `initialize()`.
  - [`useRouteRef.tsx`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.tsx#L36-L51): Subscribes to `routeResolutionApi.subscribe?.()` in `useEffect` and re-evaluates `routeResolutionApi.resolve` when notified.
  - [`36-routes.md`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/docs/frontend-system/architecture/36-routes.md), [`03-built-in-extensions.md`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/docs/frontend-system/building-apps/03-built-in-extensions.md), and patch changesets for `@backstage/frontend-app-api` and `@backstage/frontend-plugin-api`.
